name: react-tablekit-monorepo
description: Monorepo for react-tablekit (library) and its demo + API docs site.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter react-tablekit run build && pnpm --filter site run build
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter site run build:data && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter react-tablekit run lint:css-tokens && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm size && pnpm check:package && pnpm docs:check && pnpm conformance && pnpm e2e
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
